propositions: Auto-deploy container restarts interrupt in-flight code reviews because shutdown drain timeout (45s) is too short relative to review timeout (1200s), causing fail-closed -1 votes that block backfill reconciliation
Increase DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS from 45 to 1200 and resize compose stop_grace_period to 1320s to quiesce and allow in-flight reviews to complete before termination

Defer vote posting for retryable coverage gaps (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) and record attempts in a new review_attempts ledger so the backfill reconciler can retry without being blocked by a veto
Escalate to fail-closed -1 vote with retries-exhausted note and emit VOTER_ERROR alarm after RETRYABLE_GAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3) consecutive retryable failures on the same change/revision

Classify decision outcomes with machine-readable gap_reason keys in adapter to distinguish terminal failures (finding, indeterminate, gate-disabled) that require -1 votes from transient conditions eligible for no-vote deferral

Keep terminal outcomes (finding, indeterminate) and merge-path failures as fail-closed -1 votes; ensure vote-less changes remain unsubmittable and no reconciler degraded mode treats missing votes as submittable
